description.value: Old Xian's Food is a fast-casual Chinese chain specializing in the bold regional flavours of Xi'an, including hand-pulled wide belt noodles, cold noodles, and meat-filled burgers (roujiamo). The Burnaby location on Kingsway operates a hybrid restaurant-and-mart concept, selling grab-and-go hot bowls, bento boxes, sauces, and frozen goods alongside dine-in and takeout meals. The chain has received coverage in local food media for bringing relatively uncommon Northwestern Chinese cuisine to Metro Vancouver.
